basic_profile.bio: An avid tech enthusiast hailing from Osaka, I have a passion for digital content creation and video editing. I work as a freelance video editor and spend my free time gaming and exploring new technologies. I appreciate well-optimized software and have a keen interest in hardware performance. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work. I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy sharing tech tips with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and years of hands-on experience in video editing, I have developed a robust understanding of both software and hardware. I continually learn through online courses and community discussions, focusing on optimizing workflows and staying updated with the latest tech trends.
